title: Continuity of Care Schedule for Prior Authorization
content:
**Continuity of care settings.** For a new member of Prairie Ridge Health Plan, each Prior Authorization class sets the transition period — the calendar days after the member's plan coverage start date during which an authorization from the prior health plan is honored — whether honoring it needs the prior plan's authorization number, and whether it is honored even when the servicing provider is out of network.

| Class | Transition period (calendar days after the coverage start date) | Prior plan's authorization number needed | Honored with an out-of-network servicing provider |
|---|---|---|---|
| Advanced Imaging Authorization | 90 | Yes | Yes |
| Outpatient Rehabilitation Therapy Authorization | 90 | Yes | Yes |
| Durable Medical Equipment Authorization | 90 | Yes | Yes |
| Home Health Services Authorization | 90 | Yes | Yes |
| Behavioral Health Intensive Services Authorization | 90 | Yes | Yes |
| Elective Inpatient and Surgical Authorization | 90 | Yes | Yes |
| Out-of-Network Services Authorization | 90 | Yes | Yes |

**The same settings, stated per member.** Whatever the class, a new member's prior-plan authorization is honored within a transition period of 90 calendar days after the plan coverage start date; the prior plan's authorization number is needed in every class; and an out-of-network servicing provider does not prevent the authorization from being honored in any class.

**Hypothetical reading.** For a hypothetical member whose Prairie Ridge coverage started on the first day of a month, the transition period of every class is the 90 calendar days that follow that start date.
